I will put two bags of NPK fertilizer on this rice plot because the government sells it at a subsidized price and my soil is tired after many years of farming. I kept good seed from last year's harvest, so I will not waste money buying new seed from the market. My family will do the weeding and harvesting ourselves, but I will hire two young men for a couple of days to help with transplanting when the rains come. We do not spray chemicals on rice; we will remove the weeds with our hands.
